title: Round 12 / algorithm inventor B
question: Representation-change algorithms: invent ECDLP algorithms that move the instance to a different representation or object (alternative curve models, x-only/Kummer arithmetic, isogeny walks, covers, structured maps to other groups or to algebraic systems) where the scalar becomes cheaper to recover, escaping the lab's transfer and isogeny-invariance barriers; prototype and benchmark against Pollard rho.
success_criteria: Exact statements; reproducible evidence; honest negatives.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; <= 10 web lookups; computations < 5 min each; no commits; ~90 min.
